description: Run weekly by the home-server repository's jobs/ stack (jobs/README.md there). One grouped PR for the base image and the PyPI pins, never automerged: the home server rebuilds this repository's image every morning from whatever is checked out.

packageRules.description: Everything in one branch and one PR. A major bump still gets its own PR.
prBodyNotes: After merging, on the home server: `git fetch && git log --stat HEAD..origin/main` in the checkout (only commits you made or merged), then `git pull`. The next 07:00 run builds and uses it; `sudo systemctl start home-server-stocks.service` to try it now.
